import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Solution {

    static class State {
        int p, x, lastTwo;
        State(int p, int x, int lastTwo) {
            this.p = p;
            this.x = x;
            this.lastTwo = lastTwo;
        }
        @Override
        public boolean equals(Object o) {
            if (this == o) return true;
            if (!(o instanceof State)) return false;
            State s = (State) o;
            return p == s.p && x == s.x && lastTwo == s.lastTwo;
        }
        @Override
        public int hashCode() {
            return Objects.hash(p, x, lastTwo);
        }
    }

    static Map<State, Integer> memo;
    static String str;
    static int len;

    public static int f(int p, int x, int lastTwo) {
        if (p == len) {
            if (lastTwo == 0 || lastTwo == 25 || lastTwo == 50 || lastTwo == 75) return 1;
            return 0;
        }
        State key = new State(p, x, lastTwo);
        if (memo.containsKey(key)) return memo.get(key);
        int ans = 0;
        char c = str.charAt(p);
        if (c == 'X') {
            if (x != 10) {
                ans = f(p + 1, x, (lastTwo % 10) * 10 + x);
            } else {
                for (int i = (p == 0 ? 1 : 0); i < 10; i++) {
                    ans += f(p + 1, i, (lastTwo % 10) * 10 + i);
                }
            }
        } else if (c == '_') {
            for (int i = (p == 0 ? 1 : 0); i < 10; i++) {
                ans += f(p + 1, x, (lastTwo % 10) * 10 + i);
            }
        } else {
            ans += f(p + 1, x, (lastTwo % 10) * 10 + (c - '0'));
        }
        memo.put(key, ans);
        return ans;
    }

    public static void solve(InputReader in, PrintWriter out) {
        str = in.next();
        len = str.length();
        if (len == 1) {
            if (str.charAt(0) == '0') out.println(1);
            else out.println(0);
        } else if (str.charAt(0) == '0') {
            out.println(0);
        } else {
            memo = new HashMap<>();
            out.println(f(0, 10, 0));
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        InputStream inputStream = System.in;
        OutputStream outputStream = System.out;
        InputReader in = new InputReader(inputStream);
        PrintWriter out = new PrintWriter(outputStream);
        solve(in, out);
        out.close();
    }

    static class InputReader {
        public BufferedReader reader;
        public StringTokenizer tokenizer;

        public InputReader(InputStream stream) {
            reader = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(stream), 32768);
            tokenizer = null;
        }

        public String next() {
            while (tokenizer == null || !tokenizer.hasMoreTokens()) {
                try {
                    tokenizer = new StringTokenizer(reader.readLine());
                } catch (IOException e) {
                    throw new RuntimeException(e);
                }
            }
            return tokenizer.nextToken();
        }

        public int nextInt() {
            return Integer.parseInt(next());
        }

        public long nextLong() {
            return Long.parseLong(next());
        }
    }
}

import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Solution {

    public static int solveDP(String str) {
        int len = str.length();
        if (len == 1) {
            return str.charAt(0) == '0' ? 1 : 0;
        }
        if (str.charAt(0) == '0') return 0;

        int[][][] dp = new int[len + 1][11][100];
        // base: at position len
        for (int x = 0; x <= 10; x++) {
            for (int last = 0; last < 100; last++) {
                if (last == 0 || last == 25 || last == 50 || last == 75) {
                    dp[len][x][last] = 1;
                } else {
                    dp[len][x][last] = 0;
                }
            }
        }

        for (int p = len - 1; p >= 0; p--) {
            for (int x = 0; x <= 10; x++) {
                for (int last = 0; last < 100; last++) {
                    int ans = 0;
                    char c = str.charAt(p);
                    if (c == 'X') {
                        if (x != 10) {
                            ans = dp[p + 1][x][(last % 10) * 10 + x];
                        } else {
                            for (int i = (p == 0 ? 1 : 0); i < 10; i++) {
                                ans += dp[p + 1][i][(last % 10) * 10 + i];
                            }
                        }
                    } else if (c == '_') {
                        for (int i = (p == 0 ? 1 : 0); i < 10; i++) {
                            ans += dp[p + 1][x][(last % 10) * 10 + i];
                        }
                    } else {
                        ans += dp[p + 1][x][(last % 10) * 10 + (c - '0')];
                    }
                    dp[p][x][last] = ans;
                }
            }
        }
        return dp[0][10][0];
    }

    public static void solve(InputReader in, PrintWriter out) {
        String str = in.next();
        out.println(solveDP(str));
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        InputStream inputStream = System.in;
        OutputStream outputStream = System.out;
        InputReader in = new InputReader(inputStream);
        PrintWriter out = new PrintWriter(outputStream);
        solve(in, out);
        out.close();
    }

    static class InputReader {
        public BufferedReader reader;
        public StringTokenizer tokenizer;

        public InputReader(InputStream stream) {
            reader = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(stream), 32768);
            tokenizer = null;
        }

        public String next() {
            while (tokenizer == null || !tokenizer.hasMoreTokens()) {
                try {
                    tokenizer = new StringTokenizer(reader.readLine());
                } catch (IOException e) {
                    throw new RuntimeException(e);
                }
            }
            return tokenizer.nextToken();
        }

        public int nextInt() {
            return Integer.parseInt(next());
        }

        public long nextLong() {
            return Long.parseLong(next());
        }
    }

import java.util.*;

public class Solution {

    // Count numbers for a fixed digit d for all X positions
    public static int countForDigit(String str, int d) {
        int len = str.length();
        if (len == 1) {
            return (str.charAt(0) == '0' || (str.charAt(0) == 'X' && d == 0)) ? 1 : 0;
        }
        if (str.charAt(0) == '0') return 0;
        if (str.charAt(0) == 'X' && d == 0) return 0;

        int[][] dp = new int[len + 1][100];
        // base: at end
        for (int last = 0; last < 100; last++) {
            if (last == 0 || last == 25 || last == 50 || last == 75) dp[len][last] = 1;
            else dp[len][last] = 0;
        }

        for (int p = len - 1; p >= 0; p--) {
            for (int last = 0; last < 100; last++) {
                int ans = 0;
                char c = str.charAt(p);
                if (c == 'X') {
                    ans = dp[p + 1][(last % 10) * 10 + d];
                } else if (c == '_') {
                    for (int i = (p == 0 ? 1 : 0); i < 10; i++) {
                        ans += dp[p + 1][(last % 10) * 10 + i];
                    }
                } else {
                    ans += dp[p + 1][(last % 10) * 10 + (c - '0')];
                }
                dp[p][last] = ans;
            }
        }
        return dp[0][0];
    }

    public static void solve(Scanner sc) {
        String str = sc.next();
        int len = str.length();
        if (len == 1) {
            if (str.charAt(0) == '0') {
                System.out.println(1);
            } else if (str.charAt(0) == 'X') {
                System.out.println(1); // only digit 0 works
            } else {
                System.out.println(0);
            }
            return;
        }
        if (str.charAt(0) == '0') {
            System.out.println(0);
            return;
        }

        // Check if there is any X
        boolean hasX = false;
        for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) {
            if (str.charAt(i) == 'X') {
                hasX = true;
                break;
            }
        }
        if (!hasX) {
            // No X, just count with a dummy digit (e.g., 0) but X not present, so use any digit
            System.out.println(countForDigit(str, 0));
            return;
        }

        int total = 0;
        for (int d = 0; d <= 9; d++) {
            // leading zero check: if first char is X and d==0, skip
            if (str.charAt(0) == 'X' && d == 0) continue;
            total += countForDigit(str, d);
        }
        System.out.println(total);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        solve(sc);
        sc.close();
    }
}
